# Dr. Anam's Dental

> Dr. Anam's Dental is a complete dental clinic for adults and children in Bolarum, Secunderabad (Hyderabad, Telangana, India), close to Kompally and Dulapally. It is led by Dr. Chandra Sekar Anam, MDS, a prosthodontist and implantologist and Professor of Prosthodontics, with specialist dentists for each branch of dentistry.

## Clinic facts

- Name: Dr. Anam's Dental
- Address: 6th Floor (Unit 612), Fairmount Downtown Building, X Road, Doolapally Road, Sri Ganesh Nagar, Bolarum, Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana 500100, India
- Areas served: Bolarum, Kompally, Dulapally, Jeedimetla, Secunderabad and north Hyderabad
- Phone: 040-27638169 (appointments are booked by phone)
- Email: anamsdentalclinic@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM. Closed on Sunday.
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/sNM6msj4zvmMWUXy6
- Equipment: 3D CBCT imaging, digital intraoral scanner, Class-B autoclave sterilisation, computerised occlusion (bite) analysis

## Lead dentist

- Dr. Chandra Sekar Anam, MDS (Prosthodontics), prosthodontist and implantologist, 30+ years of experience
- Professor of Prosthodontics; former National Vice President of the Indian Prosthodontic Society (IPS)
- Member of the Indian Prosthodontic Society, the Indian Dental Association and the American Academy of Implant Dentistry
- Trained at Bapuji Dental College
- Profile: https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/about

## Treatments

- [All treatments](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments): overview of every treatment offered
- [Check-ups and fillings (general dentistry)](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/general-dentistry): examinations, tooth-coloured fillings, toothache and sensitivity
- [Teeth cleaning and gum treatment](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/gum-treatment): scaling and polishing, deep cleaning, bleeding gums, gum disease
- [Kids' dentistry (paediatric dentistry)](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/kids-dentistry): check-ups, fluoride, sealants, fillings and baby-tooth treatment
- [Root canal treatment](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/root-canal-treatment): saving infected or painful teeth, re-treatment
- [Tooth extraction and wisdom teeth](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/tooth-extraction-wisdom-teeth): simple and surgical extractions, impacted wisdom teeth
- [Braces and Invisalign clear aligners](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/braces-and-aligners): metal braces, ceramic braces, clear aligners, retainers
- [Cosmetic dentistry](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/treatments/cosmetic-dentistry): teeth whitening, veneers, bonding, smile design
- [Dental implants](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/specialisations/dental-implants): single-tooth implants and full-arch All-on-4 / All-on-6
- [Prosthodontics](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/specialisations/prosthodontics): dentures and replacement of missing teeth
- [Crowns and bridges](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/specialisations/crowns-and-bridges)
- [Advanced restorative dentistry](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/specialisations/advanced-restorative-dentistry)
- [Full mouth rehabilitation](https://anamsdentalclinic.pages.dev/specialisations/full-mouth-rehabilitation)
